comparison.objective: Hold a test probe on two moving pallet pads for timed intervals; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Moving-target tracking with sustained probe contact versus key insertion, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding and repeated-cycle inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Two uninterrupted 2-second contacts before the end line versus two acceptable carriage stops and retained collar adjustment.
comparison.reason: Probe tracking and timed contact are materially different from response-based tuning. Candidate does not quantify excessive rebound, overload, collar drift or witness torque.
